_comment: Plugin store catalogue. Paste the GitHub URL of a plugin folder - name, version, author, description and preview image are read from its own plugin.json. Refresh in the store always downloads this file from 'self_url' and caches it in ~/.config/OSC-DreamChatbox/plugins.json, so AppImage and AUR users get new plugins without updating the app. 'version' is optional and only matters if a later app release ships a newer catalogue than the cached one. Private additions belong in ~/.config/OSC-DreamChatbox/plugins_sources.json, which is never overwritten.
